name: Light Infantry
postRollNote: Swords do not score hits for this unit in Close Combat.

name: Light Bow Infantry
postRollNote: Swords do not score hits for this unit in Close Combat.

name: Light Sling Infantry
postRollNote: Swords do not score hits for this unit in Close Combat.

name: Warrior Infantry
postRollNote: Full-strength Warriors may ignore one flag. If they lose the first block during this same combat and Battle Back, they still use the full-strength bonus for that Battle Back.
special: 4 dice when full strength, ignore 1 flag when full strength

name: Medium Hoplite Infantry
postRollNote: Hoplite rule: when in effect, may be ordered by Mounted Charge or Order Mounted; Mounted Charge gives +1 Close Combat die when applicable.
special: same normal combat profile as Medium Infantry; Hoplite card/scenario rule may apply

name: Light Cavalry
postRollNote: NOTE: SABERS do NOT score hits for Light Cavalry in Close Combat
special: retreat +1 hex per flag when attacked by elephants/camels

name: Light Bow Cavalry
postRollNote: Swords do not score hits for this unit in Close Combat.
special: retreat +1 hex per flag when attacked by elephants/camels

name: Medium Cavalry
special: evade only vs foot and heavy mounted

name: Heavy Cavalry
special: evade only vs foot and elephants

name: Light Barbarian Chariot
postRollNote: Chariot units ignore one sword hit in Close Combat. Full-strength Light Barbarian Chariots may ignore one flag.
special: 3 dice at full strength else 2; ignore 1 sword

name: Heavy Chariot
postRollNote: Chariot units ignore one sword hit in Close Combat. Heavy Chariots roll 3 dice when Battling Back.

name: Camel
postRollNote: Against cavalry or chariots, Camel may ignore one blue triangle hit; cavalry/chariots retreat one additional hex per flag rolled by the Camel.
special: ignore 1 symbol when attacked by cavalry/chariot

name: Cataphract Camel
postRollNote: Cataphracted Camel may ignore one sword hit. Against cavalry or chariots, it may also ignore one blue triangle hit; cavalry/chariots retreat one additional hex per flag rolled by the Camel.
special: ignore 1 sword and 1 symbol when attacked by cavalry/chariot

name: Heavy Cataphract Cavalry
postRollNote: Cataphracted Heavy Cavalry may ignore one sword hit in Close Combat.

name: Light War Machine
postRollNote: War machines do not score hits on sword symbols in Close Combat.
special: evade then removed; no take ground; swords no hit

name: Heavy War Machine
postRollNote: War machines do not score hits on sword symbols in Close Combat.
special: evade then removed; no take ground; swords no hit

name: Elephant
postRollNote: Elephants ignore all sword hits. Elephant sword hits are rerolled unless the target ignores that sword. Elephants receive no leader benefit.
special: swords hit and reroll; vs elephants/camels/warriors/HCH roll 3 dice; otherwise same as attacker; ignore all swords when attacked

name: Leader
special: attached leader adds helmets as hits (not to elephants)
